preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: Every character in the input string is a valid hexadecimal digit (0-9, a-f).
The input string has length between 1 and 14 (inclusive).
At least one character in the input string is non-zero.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (len(stdout.strip()) == len(stdin.strip()) and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in stdout.strip()))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is 'NO'; otherwise, output is a valid hexadecimal string of the same length as input.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != 'NO' implies (lambda s: int(s, 16))(stdout.strip()) == min([(lambda s: int(s, 16))(candidate) for candidate in permutations if (lambda s: int(s, 16))(candidate) + (lambda s: int(s, 16))(stdin.strip()) == (lambda s: int(s, 16))(stdin.strip()) + (lambda s: int(s, 16))(candidate)])
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output is the smallest possible numerical value of the original string, where the original and copied strings are permutations of each other and their absolute difference matches the input.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != 'NO' implies (lambda s: int(s, 16))(stdout.strip()) + (lambda s: int(s, 16))(stdin.strip()) == (lambda s: int(s, 16))(stdin.strip()) + (lambda s: int(s, 16))(stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the sum of the original and copied strings' numerical values equals the sum of the input string's numerical value and the original string's numerical value (trivially true, but ensures the difference is preserved).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != 'NO' implies (lambda s: sorted(s))(stdout.strip()) == (lambda s: sorted(s))(stdin.strip())
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output string is a permutation of the input string (same multiset of digits).
